title: Wind tunnel test of A-12 model (CIA OXCART history, p. 272)
description: Full-height black-and-white photograph of a scale model of the A-12 mounted nose-up on a support sting, viewed from above the nose against a dark background. The sidebar caption reads "Wind tunnel test of A-12 model." The page is from Chapter 6 of the CIA overhead reconnaissance history and is otherwise blank apart from Secret NOFORN markings.
